title: Date["now"]() is the same host-sensitive access as Date.now() and still requires a capability
notes: specification/compatibility.mdx, 'Host Globals': 'Facilities truly present in every supported JavaScript environment MAY be unconditional globals. Host-sensitive operations such as clock and random access MUST still use capabilities.' 20-host-globals/clock-access-needs-a-capability pins the dotted spelling. This is a regression pin rather than a fix: the ambient-authority recognizer already tested for a string literal element access, which is why the host-global table was the one family the computed-access defect never reached — and it is the precedent the rest of the family was fixed to follow, so it is worth a row that would notice it being dropped.
